doc.name: Job Alerts
doc.instructions: Catalog of open internship and new-grad roles read from company career sites. search_roles lists open roles; get_role fetches one by id. list_tracks, list_groups and list_companies give the values the track, group and company filters take. Results default to US-eligible roles that do not require US citizenship or a clearance; pass us_only=false, country, or include_clearance=true to widen. Send people to apply_url to apply. Without a Realtime key, roles appear 60 minutes after they are first detected. recent_changes (Realtime) is a feed of roles announced and closed.

tools.name: search_roles
tools.title: Search roles
tools.description: Open intern and new-grad roles, newest posting first. Returns {data: Role[], next_cursor, total}. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page. Page size is up to 20 without an API key and 100 with one. Without a Realtime key, roles first detected within the Free plan's delay (minutes in the server instructions) are left out, and employer_url and ats_job_id are null. include_evidence (Realtime) adds the posting sentences behind the sponsorship, citizenship, clearance and graduation fields.

query.description: Text the role title or company name contains, matched as one phrase. REST: q.

track.description: Any of these tracks, as an array or a comma-separated string. "swe" covers frontend, backend and fullstack. REST: track.

group.description: Company group slugs from list_groups, any of them; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: group.

company.description: Exact company name as list_companies returns it. REST: company.

exclude_companies.description: Company names to leave out; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: exclude.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, an array or a comma-separated string. Setting it replaces the US-only default. REST: country.

workplace.description: Workplace types, any of them; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: workplace.

us_only.description: Default true: roles open to US applicants. false lifts it. REST: us=0.

include_clearance.description: Default false hides roles requiring US citizenship, US-person status or a clearance. REST: clearance=1.

sponsorship.description: For an applicant who needs visa sponsorship. "needed" hides roles whose posting says no sponsorship; roles that do not say, or are not read yet, stay in. "available" keeps only roles whose posting says it sponsors. REST: sponsorship.

citizenship.description: "not_required" hides roles whose posting requires US citizenship or US-person status (eligibility.citizenship_required true). Roles not read yet stay in. With include_clearance=true it keeps clearance roles that state no citizenship requirement. REST: citizenship.

undergrad.description: true hides roles that accept only graduate degrees. REST: undergrad=1, or degree=bachelors.

degree.description: Keep roles open to this degree program: a posting that names the degrees it accepts must include it; one naming none stays in. REST: degree.

graduation_year.description: Hide roles whose graduation window excludes this year. REST: grad.

since.description: Only roles posted within this window. REST: since.

posted_after.description: ISO 8601 time; only roles posted at or after it.

tools.name: get_role
tools.title: Get role
tools.description: One role by its numeric id, including closed roles (status "closed", apply_url null). apply_url is the link to send a person to. With a Realtime key, employer_url is the employer posting (fetch it for the description) and ats_job_id the ATS id; both are null otherwise. include_evidence is Realtime.

id.description: Role id from search_roles or a /roles/<id> link.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.title: List tracks
tools.description: The job tracks the track filter takes (swe, data-ai, quant, ...), with open early-career role counts across every country.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.title: List company groups
tools.description: Company groups the group filter takes: curated lists (faang, ai-companies, quant-hft, ...) and sectors, with member counts.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: Companies with open early-career roles, most roles first, with their groups and ATS. open_roles counts every country. Pass a name to the company filter of search_roles exactly as returned here.

group.description: Only companies in any of these groups; an array or a comma-separated string.

query.description: Part of the company name or slug.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.title: Recent changes
tools.description: Feed of role.created (announced) and role.closed events, oldest first after the given event id. Without after, returns the latest events. Pass next_after back as after to poll. Requires an API key on the Realtime plan.

after.description: Event id to read after: next_after from the previous call.

types.description: role.created, role.closed, or both (the default); an array or a comma-separated string.
